paragraphs: He is mentioned in Nazir 38b, raising an objection to Rav Ashi; Hyman calls this a scribal error and says the reading should be Rava of Parzakya, as explained in his entry.[^1]

notes.text: The whole Davidson Nazir 38b paragraph has Ravina of Parzikya addressing Rav Ashi. Hyman’s Parzakya form, objection summary and emphatic proposed reading Rava of Parzakya remain his account. The cross-reference is unbound; no scribal correction is applied to Hebrew or admitted as printed correction history.
